Summing r physical inter-spike intervals gives precisely mr+ceil(r beta), and one positive delay. A rational q-grid avoids the hole exactly at eta>=1-1/q; disjoint translates give |E|=q eta-q+1 and unique q-point orbit precisely at equality. Upper records of {j beta} generate monotone rational plateaux; the Diophantine bound follows from 1-{r beta} >= ||r beta||. The exact-fraction checker tests 2356 rational cases, and finite high-precision irrational sampling tests 210492 subcases; these tests are corroboration, not proof of the infinite assertions.
